name: Zaply.me – Customer Videos & UGC for WooCommerce
author: zaplyme

sections.description:
Zaply.me helps your shop get authentic customer videos and turn them into marketing materials.
After an order is completed, the plugin invites your customers to record a short
vertical video. Use their recordings in ads, on product pages and on social media,
within the consent they give. The reward is a coupon for submitting a recording and
agreeing to its use, on your shop’s terms, regardless of the recording’s sentiment.

Why stores use Zaply.me

  • More trust on product pages – real people showing your product beat star ratings.
  • Ready-made ad creatives – vertical 9:16 videos with captions for Reels, TikTok and Meta Ads.
  • Automatic rewards – a WooCommerce coupon for submitting a recording and agreeing to its use, on your shop’s terms. Technical approval checks clarity and compliance with the rules, regardless of the recording’s sentiment.
  • No app for the customer – they record in the browser from a link in the email.
  • Your mail, your brand – invitations go out through your WooCommerce mailer.

How it works in 3 steps

  1. Connect your store using a pairing code from Zaply.me → Profile → Integrations → WooCommerce. Paste it under WooCommerce → Zaply.me, then set the invitation delay and coupon value.
  2. Customers receive an invitation after a completed order and record a video from the email link. The reward is a coupon for submitting a recording and agreeing to its use, on your shop’s terms.
  3. Check the recording for clarity and compliance with the rules in Zaply.me. After technical approval, the plugin sends the coupon. Download the videos you want to use within the customer’s consent; the reward remains due even if you do not publish the video.

Good fit for

Natural cosmetics, pet accessories, shoes, bags and jewellery – any product that looks better in a customer’s hands.

Privacy

Customer email addresses are not sent to the Zaply.me API by this plugin. Review invitations and reward emails are sent by your WooCommerce mailer. See “External services” below for the full list of data the plugin sends and receives.

The plugin stores a recording-link token and the invitation and reward email status on the WooCommerce order. WordPress personal-data export lists the order number, whether the invitation and reward were sent, the coupon code, and the scheduled time. It does not include the token or the connection secret. Erasing personal data removes that order meta and cancels a pending invitation. The order, its notes, and any coupon already issued stay in the store.

Deactivating the plugin keeps its settings, order meta, and scheduled actions. Deleting the plugin removes those settings, order meta, and scheduled actions. Coupons are kept. On a multisite network, deleting the plugin from one site cleans only that site.

External services

This plugin connects to the Zaply.me service, which is required for it to work. Zaply.me hosts the page where customers record videos and the dashboard where the store manages them. The plugin does not contact the production API from local or development sites (localhost, private IP addresses, or the WordPress environment types “local” and “development”).

Zaply.me API (https://api.zaply.me)

  • Connecting the store – the first connection sends a POST request to https://api.zaply.me/v1/integrations/woocommerce/register with a single-use pairing code and the store URL. Generate the code in Zaply.me → Profile → Integrations → WooCommerce; it expires after 30 minutes. The API returns a shared secret and the company slug. Reconnecting an already paired store, or clicking “Check connection”, sends the company slug and the store URL with that secret in the X-Zaplyme-Secret header. “Check connection” does not create a secret, an order, or an email. Older plugin versions without the pairing code field cannot connect new stores.
  • Registering an order – when an order reaches the “Completed” status, and again when the delayed invitation is about to be sent, the plugin sends a POST request to https://api.zaply.me/v1/orders/register with the company slug, the WooCommerce order ID, and the customer’s billing first name (or billing last name if the first name is empty, otherwise the word “Klient”). The API returns a token used to build the customer’s review link and tells the plugin whether invitations are allowed (they are allowed only after the store’s review terms URL is set in Zaply.me).
  • All requests use HTTPS with SSL verification and include the shared secret in the X-Zaplyme-Secret header.

Review link (https://zaply.me)

The invitation email contains a link to https://zaply.me/r/{company-slug}?order={order ID}&token={token}. When the customer opens it, the video is recorded and stored by Zaply.me, not by your WordPress site.

Incoming notifications from Zaply.me

The plugin registers the REST route /wp-json/zaplyme/v1/video-approved (also available as /index.php?rest_route=/zaplyme/v1/video-approved). After you approve a video in Zaply.me, the service calls this route with the order ID and the customer’s consent choice for using the video. Requests without a valid X-Zaplyme-Secret header are rejected. The plugin then sends the reward email with the coupon.

What is not sent

The plugin does not send customer email addresses, phone numbers, postal addresses, order items, or payment data to Zaply.me. Review and reward emails are sent by your store’s WooCommerce mailer and can be disabled individually in WooCommerce → Settings → Emails.

This service is provided by Zaply.me: Terms of Service, Privacy Policy.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Zaply.me account?

Yes. Create one at https://zaply.me – setup takes a few minutes.

Does the customer need to install an app?

No. The video is recorded in the mobile browser.

When is the invitation sent?

After the order reaches the “Completed” status, once the delay you set in WooCommerce → Zaply.me has passed. On a live store that delay is 1 to 10 days. Each order is invited once, unless you send the invitation again from the order screen.

When does a recording qualify for a reward?

The coupon is for submitting a recording and agreeing to its use, regardless of review content. Approval means checking that the recording is clear and follows the rules, not judging whether the review is favourable. The reward remains due even if you choose not to publish the video.

Can I use the videos in ads?

Yes, within the consent the customer gives in your review terms (configured in Zaply.me).

Does it work with my theme?

Yes. The plugin does not change your theme. After an invitation is sent, the customer can open the recording link from My Account → View order. You can turn that link off in WooCommerce → Zaply.me.

What information is sent to Zaply.me?

On the first connection: the store URL and a single-use pairing code. For a store that is already connected: the company slug and the store URL. For each eligible order: the company slug, the order ID, and the customer’s billing first name (or last name if the first name is empty). The customer’s email address is not sent to the Zaply.me API by this plugin. See “External services” for details.

Where are customer emails sent from?

From your store. Review invitations and reward emails are sent by WooCommerce through your store’s configured mail transport (for example your SMTP plugin), using your WooCommerce email styling. You can edit or disable both emails in WooCommerce → Settings → Emails.

Is it available in Polish?

Yes. Since version 1.0.2 the plugin includes a Polish translation (pl_PL) of the settings screen, order notes, and both customer emails. Version 1.1.0 updates that translation for the new screens. It is used automatically when your site language is set to Polish.
sections.changelog:
1.1.0

  • New stores connect with a single-use pairing code from Zaply.me (Profile → Integrations → WooCommerce). The code expires after 30 minutes. Stores that are already connected keep their secret and do not need a code. “Check connection” does not create a secret, an order, or an email.
  • Settings are under WooCommerce → Zaply.me.
  • Review invitations are scheduled only after the order status is Completed. A pending invitation is canceled if the order leaves Completed, is fully refunded, or is trashed.
  • Live stores choose a delay of 1–10 days after Completed. Local and development sites can still use minutes.
  • Invitation filters: minimum order value, orders that contain only virtual or downloadable products, WooCommerce Subscriptions renewals, and product categories to include or exclude.
  • The orders list has a Zaply column, and each order has a Zaply box with the status, Send now, Send again, Cancel schedule, and Copy link. This works with High-Performance Order Storage.
  • A failed invitation is retried after 15 minutes, 1 hour, 6 hours, and 24 hours, up to 5 attempts. Waiting for the store terms link does not use those attempts. Overdue invitations go out from WooCommerce → Zaply.me, or from a daily task, after the terms link is saved in Zaply.me.
  • If the reward email is disabled, no coupon is created. The reward is sent later from WooCommerce → Zaply.me, or by a daily task, once that email is enabled.
  • The review invitation can include the placeholders {product_name} and {product_names}.
  • After the invitation is sent, My Account → View order can show the recording link. Turn this off under WooCommerce → Zaply.me.
  • WordPress personal-data export and erasure include the Zaply order status. The recording token and the connection secret are not exported. Deleting the plugin removes its settings, Zaply order data, and scheduled actions. Coupons are kept. Deactivating the plugin keeps them.
  • Updated the Polish translation.

1.0.2

  • Added Polish language

1.0.1

  • Readme, screenshots and assets updated.
  • Improving automatically generated code
